text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O had submitted a request 
to use the studio at night, so I came to 
check on her...
choice_data_list: You're working hard late again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is my third retake for the 
assigned piece, so I'm really on the 
edge."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You only practiced linear choreography and 
steps, so it's entirely your own fault.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If only the whole world were just straight 
lines...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Complaining gloomily isn't going to change 
anything.
choice_data_list: Sorry for dragging you into this.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Because turning a blind eye to 
Calstone-san's plight would be a disgrace 
to chivalry."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us overcome these curved 
movements tonight. We must minimize any 
factor that could cost us points.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No... shouldn't we rather hone the linear 
movements you excel at?
choice_data_list:
Let's go with the reliable Durandal's 
sensible opinion.

Let's bet on Light O's super aggressive 
plan!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No way... Even you, Trainer, are trying to 
taint me with curvy movements...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If you end up needing a quadruple retest, 
I'm not going to practice with you 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... It cannot be helped. As they say, a 
bend in the path brings no lasting shame.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Don't go making up proverbs!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Guh... My mind...! It's being overwhelmed 
by curves...!
choice_data_list:
I'm fine! My body might be bent, but my 
heart is true!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My heart is... set straight ahead...! 
Ooooohhh...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: How much do you hate turning?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She worked late into the night to overcome 
her weak movements, and passed her third 
retake test the following day.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Haven't you been infected by Light 
O-san's wild ideas?
choice_data_list:
I figured I'd have a better shot doing 
this now than trying to overcome my 
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That is correct. Bonus points... can 
transcend limits!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It can't be helped. Let's just 
give it our best shot.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...What is this terrifying intensity...! 
The quality of her weak spots hasn't 
changed at all...! Yet on sheer momentum 
alone... I'm being overwhelmed?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The special training continued late into 
the night, and miraculously, she passed 
her third retake test the next day.
